resources.string: A quiet place for Quran, knowledge, and worship
Read comfortably, listen to your preferred reciter, and save your place.
Explore scholars, ordered lessons, books, and source-attributed search.
Keep your adhkar counter and plan your recitation and night prayer.
A verified account keeps your progress and private insights without competition or judgment.
Sign in to continue your journey with Athar.
3–24 lowercase English letters, digits, or underscores.
This username is already in use or unavailable. Try another one.
The email provider accepted the code message. It may take a little while to arrive; check your spam folder too.
The code could not be sent. Your account is still pending; request a new code later.
If this address is registered, a recovery code will be sent.
Your password was updated. You can sign in now.
Connection failed. Check your network and try again.
Showing data saved on this device. It will update when connected.
This is a private planning aid only. Saving it does not mean the verses were read and does not change Quran or Khatmah progress.
No Night Prayer reading plan is saved.
This plan is separate from Quran reading position and Khatmah progress. It is not recorded as progress unless you explicitly choose “Record completed”.
This position belongs only to the Night Prayer plan. Quran and Khatmah positions were not changed.
The full planned range is covered by explicitly recorded sessions
Explicitly choose the Maghrib date this session belongs to. After midnight, the night date may be the previous civil date.
A safe night identity cannot be calculated yet. Save the city, time zone, and calculation method first; Maghrib and Fajr will not be guessed.
The night of %1$s is in progress
The upcoming night is anchored to Maghrib on %1$s
Next display reference: %1$d verses. It is not an obligation or pressure streak.
Night dates follow the local Maghrib date when saved prayer settings are available. After midnight, records remain attached to that Maghrib date until Fajr.
Choose what to read, learn, or record in your journey today.
Temporarily interrupted by another audio source
Text: Tanzil Project, version 1.1. Displayed verbatim from the source.
Ayah tracking is unavailable for this recording. Audio playback remains available.
Local Android recitation review is unavailable until device and model compatibility are verified. Your microphone audio stays on your device.
Exact ayah opening will be connected when the current Quran navigation work is integrated.
Download permitted by the recorded rights basis
Download is not available for this book
Waiting for an active network connection
The book could not be downloaded. You can try again.
Only the local downloaded copy will be removed. The book and your account favorite will not be changed.
There is no downloaded copy of this book on this device.
The downloaded copy failed its integrity check. It will not be opened as a complete book.
Only explicitly recorded progress or completion is shown. Opening a screen is not counted as reading or listening.
%1$d lessons completed · %2$d adhkar completed · %3$d book downloads
Create a realistic Khatmah plan with dates and pages. Edits can remain safely on this device until connectivity returns.
This plan is finished. Start a new plan only through an explicit restart.
This plan is paused. Its data is preserved without inventing progress.
Track only real progress; the daily workload is recalculated from completed pages and time remaining.
Saved on this device · awaiting sync
0–604 pages. Night Prayer pages are never added automatically.
Night Prayer progress is not automatically transferred into Khatmah. Change pages only when you intend to record them in this plan.
The target date has passed with pages remaining. Edit the target or explicitly restart the plan.
%1$d pages ahead of the calculated path
A new plan will start today and progress will return to 0 pages. Choose the new target date.
Confirm this plan is complete? It can only be finished after 604 pages are recorded.
Check the start date, target date, and pages. The target cannot be in the past and pages must be 0–604.
Neither version was replaced automatically. Compare the device and account versions, then choose which one to keep.
There is currently no Khatmah plan on the account.
Your account and private data will be deleted. Confirm your password to continue.
Other device and browser sessions will be revoked. This current session will remain signed in.
Other sessions have been signed out.
Plan your recitation and privately record what you read in night prayer.
These are your personal records; they do not judge acceptance of worship or recitation quality.
Your measured pace: %1$.1f seconds per verse
Measured average: %1$.1f seconds per verse · from %2$d measured sessions
At least two measured sessions are needed before showing a pace average; one session is not treated as a trend.
%1$d outlier session was excluded from the average only; every session remains in your history.
Start timing only when you actually begin reading. Timing pauses when the app goes to the background and does not count time away.
Timing finished · session not saved yet
Timing paused automatically when the app moved to the background.
The session was restored paused from its last saved checkpoint; closed-app time was not counted.
Timing stopped at this night’s Fajr boundary.
Timing cannot start or resume outside the current calculated night boundaries.
Run the timer for at least one second before finishing.
The timer state could not be saved on this device. No partial prayer session was recorded.
Only the local timer measurement will be removed. No Night Prayer session will be created or changed.
The saved timer state could not be read. It was kept unchanged and no prayer session was created from it.
Only the unreadable local timer state will be removed. Use this if you no longer need to recover it.
A session was edited on another device. Neither version was overwritten automatically. Review it before keeping the server version.
Begin with one session. It is saved on this device and can be synced later.
Reference: Sunan Abu Dawud 1398, the narration about ten, one hundred and one thousand verses. Milestones are encouragement, not a judgment of worship.
Delete this session? Totals will update and the deletion will sync when connected.
Choose the date of the Maghrib that began this night, including when praying after midnight.
Check the surah, ayah and count. A range cannot pass the final verse or wrap to the beginning.
These settings are entered and saved manually. Athar does not request location permission or read GPS automatically.
City, timezone, and calculation settings were saved.
Night Prayer settings changed on another device. Reload the current account version before saving.
Night Prayer settings could not be loaded or saved right now. The saved account version was not changed.
Enter your coordinates and calculation method. These are calculated times; consult your local mosque when they differ. Your location is not accessed without permission.
A valid night could not be calculated for this location and date. Check the inputs or use reliable local times; no guessed time is displayed.
All local exemption periods will be removed from this device only. No Night Prayer session or account data will be deleted.
Optional and encrypted on this device only. They are never synced, shown to administrators, or counted as worship nights.
Playback failed. Check the connection and selected recording; stop and try again.
Choose a reference type and enter its numbers. Arabic and Western digits can be mixed.
That reference is invalid. Check the surah, ayah, or section limits.
Check the range start and end. The end must be at or after the start and remain inside the Quran.
Enter at least two letters to search the Quran text stored on this device.
Choose where to save your personal data copy. Unsynced device sessions are included; local exempt periods are excluded.
Synced account data: profile, bookmarks, favorites, plans, recorded progress and activity statistics.
Retained device data that has not been discarded: lesson progress, local Night Prayer sessions, and the pending local Khatmah plan.
Local private exemption periods are excluded
Passwords, sign-in tokens, refresh tokens, and local encryption keys are not included.
Create a copy of your data?
You will choose where to save a JSON file containing the exportable account and progress data. Treat it as a private file.
A complete export requires access to the current account. If account data cannot be retrieved, Athar will not write a partial export.
The complete account export was saved to the location you chose.
Current account data could not be retrieved. Check the connection and session, then try again. No partial export was written.
The export was prepared, but it could not be written to the selected location. Choose another location and try again.
This counter was changed on another device. Review the server version before continuing.
Choose a tafsir book for the current ayah. Source selection stays separate from the Quran text and never changes the saved canonical text.
The tafsir source is unavailable right now. Any cached copy remains visible; it will not be cleared or retried in a loop.
This book has no available explanation for the selected ayah.
No tafsir books match this search.
One dhikr at a time, with your counter saved.
This is a descriptive view of your private record only—no points, ranking, or judgment of worship.
Highest recorded verses in one night
There is not enough recorded data yet.
No session with measured duration is recorded yet.
Next reference: %1$d verses in one night; this is not a required target.
Your record has reached the highest displayed reference level; there is no competition or ranking.
A streak uses nights you explicitly recorded. Local exempt days bridge a gap only and are never added to the worship-night count.
The current night identity could not be resolved from your saved city settings. Historical streaks are still calculated only from recorded nights.
These insights are calculated for your private experience from recorded sessions and local exemption periods. They do not create a leaderboard or expose your worship dates to administrators.
%1$d recorded nights · %2$d verses · %3$d locally exempt days
This view is built on your device from your private record. It does not add an admin view of your individual worship dates.
%1$s: %2$d recorded nights, %3$d verses, %4$d locally exempt days
Your private record, including edits saved on this device. Empty dates are not a judgment about your worship.
Your comment will appear after review.

Video playback is unavailable. Retry or open it on YouTube.
Your watch position is saved automatically so you can continue later.
The video has ended. Continue to the next lesson or mark this lesson completed.
The watch position could not be saved on this device. Try again.
Press play to start the video
Your comment has been submitted for review.
The source does not specify a repetition count for this entry.
Changes from a previous day are still saved on this device. Sync or resolve them before starting today’s count; they will not be reset automatically.
%1$d completion saved on this device awaiting sync
You have reached the last entry in this section.
Saved on this device; synchronization is still pending.
Your account has a different position. Choose the position to keep.
The email or password is incorrect.
The verification code is incorrect or expired. Request a new code.
Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
These account details cannot be used. Check the email and username.
Your session has expired. Sign in again.
This account cannot perform this action.
There are no upcoming lessons right now.
This event was cancelled. Check Upcoming Lessons for new dates.
The scheduled time has arrived; waiting for the lesson to start.
This lesson is no longer available. Return to the lesson list for the latest schedule.
The lesson has ended. Its recording is not currently available to watch.
Some saved data on this device could not be read. It has been kept unchanged, and your progress has not been reset. Try again.
Save device version as a new session
This session is deleted in this version.
Review both versions before choosing. Only this session’s pending changes will be replaced; other sessions stay unchanged.
The session was deleted from your account. You can keep the device change as a new session without restoring the deleted session.
A version changed during review. Reload both before choosing; your device changes are still saved.
Another change arrived for this session. Your draft is still here; close this form and review the pending change before saving.
The rejected change is still saved on this device. Review it and retry, repair it, or use the account state; other sessions can continue syncing.
The saved change will not be discarded automatically. Review the device version and current account state before choosing an action.
The server rejected this change because some of its data is no longer accepted. You can repair it and submit a new mutation.
This session no longer exists in the account. Review the current state before retrying or accepting the account state.
The server permanently rejected this change. Its original device data is retained for review.
There is no current account copy of this session.
The session changed during review. Reopen the review before continuing; the device data is still saved.
Account data could not be read. Retry; your data has not been treated as empty or changed.
Reminders for lessons you explicitly chose to be reminded about.
Quran, adhkar, Khatmah and Night Prayer reminders you enabled yourself.
New content from scholars and series you follow.
General messages sent only with separate campaign consent.

Notification settings could not be read right now.
Notification permission was not granted, so this lesson reminder was not enabled.
Only the lesson-reminder category will be enabled when you choose it. This does not subscribe you to campaign or announcement messages, and each lesson reminder can be turned off at any time.
Notifications are disabled for this app in system settings. Open settings if you want to allow lesson reminders.
The reminder is scheduled for 15 minutes before the lesson.
The lesson is less than 15 minutes away, so Athar will not substitute a late or immediate reminder for your choice.
Follow status could not be loaded.

Notifications are disabled for this app in system settings. You can open settings to allow the wird reminder.
Your optional reminder for today’s %1$d-ayah saved-progress target.
